module2.tampered_region: The tampering is located in the central portion of the image, occupying a vertical area that stretches from the middle to the upper part of the picture. The content within this tampered area includes a person holding a large drum or instrument.
evidence: The tampering is evident due to several factors.
Firstly, there is an unnatural edge around the figure, which does not blend seamlessly with the surrounding environment.
Secondly, the lighting on the figure does not match the rest of the scene; it appears to be lit from a different angle compared to the natural outdoor lighting.
Additionally, the resolution of the figure seems inconsistent with the rest of the image, appearing slightly blurrier, which could indicate manipulation.
Shadows cast by the figure do not align with the direction of light in the rest of the photo.
